title: Missing Number
statement: `nums` contains n distinct numbers from the range 0..n. Return the one number that is missing.
hints: The sum of 0..n is n * (n + 1) / 2. Subtract the array sum.
XOR of 0..n XOR every nums[i] leaves the missing number, because pairs cancel.
Cyclic placement also works: put value v at index v and look for the empty slot.

approaches.name: Sort and scan
approaches.explanation: The first index that does not match its value is the gap.

approaches.name: Gauss or XOR
approaches.explanation: A closed formula or a cancellation.

editorial: The arithmetic solution is one subtraction. Use integer division, which is exact because n(n+1) is even. The XOR solution avoids overflow in fixed-width languages: XOR every index and every value, and XOR n at the end. Both are O(1) extra memory.
